name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with isolated local Product Packs, scope-routed Shared UI Rules, a modular Design System, and evidence-based validation.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production interfaces through product-first routing. The Skill classifies the product, loads only the active local Product Pack and scope-relevant local modules, then applies only relevant Shared Product UI Rules and Design System modules. It covers websites, dashboards, web applications, mobile applications, and WordPress plugin/admin UI while preserving product behavior and data meaning. The Design System covers semantic tokens, typography, themes, density/layout, component states, responsive/product variants, runtime configuration boundaries, and migration governance. Persian-facing language validation is delegated to persian-writing.
capabilities: Classify UI work by product before product-specific design decisions
Load only the active Product Pack and scope-relevant local modules
Apply scope-relevant Shared UI Rules and modular Design System guidance
Design and audit websites dashboards web applications mobile applications and WordPress plugin UI
Preserve product behavior accessibility boundaries and data meaning
Validate significant UI changes with rendered visual-regression and UX evidence when available
Route Persian-facing language validation to required persian-writing
defaultPrompt: Classify the product first, load only its relevant UI/UX modules, then improve it without breaking behavior.
Audit this product UI using only the rules relevant to its product type and current scope.
Improve this interface while preserving business logic data meaning and existing user changes.
